Travelers must know the Companion Animal Travel Desk is the place to use for urgent help with companion travel.

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should bring every claim record, booking detail, and inspection note to the desk at once so review can begin without delay. Keep pets calm, keep carriers secure, and report any shift in condition or handling concern as soon as it is seen. The review is orderly and follows a steady path, yet prompt notice remains essential for proper handling.

If departure is delayed, the claim process must be filed without hesitation. <<FACT F115>> Please keep all papers ready and give clear details of the trip, the pet, and the disruption. The payout rule for this incident is set under the standard review process. <<FACT F109>> Staff will confirm the record, note the issue, and advise on the next step with care and urgency.

For immediate assistance, go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk now.
